Container.Name: FRM Forge
Container.Overview: FRM Forge is a reactive operations console for Ficsit Remote Monitoring (FRM).[br][br]It provides dashboards, power and factory views, a map interface, switch and machine write actions, SQLite-backed persistence, and backend automation for schedules and threshold rules.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the FRM Forge web UI.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: SQLite database and persistent FRM Forge state.

Config.Name: FRM Base URL
Config.Description: Initial FRM API base URL, for example http://tower:8080 or http://host.docker.internal:8080. This can also be changed later in the UI.

Config.Name: FRM Token
Config.Description: Initial FRM API token for write access. This can also be changed later in the UI.

Config.Name: Default Schedule Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used for new schedules, for example America/New_York.

Config.Name: Poll Refresh Seconds
Config.Description: Initial FRM polling interval in seconds.

Config.Name: Automation Interval Seconds
Config.Description: How often automation rules are evaluated.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: SQLAlchemy database URL. Leave this on the default SQLite path unless you know you need something else.

Config.Name: Container Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone. Rules using local time follow this value.
